synopsis: Captain Rynel Starweaver selects Falanaras, Theron, and Lethira for a focused Ghostlands mission, then brings them before Ranger-General Halduron Brightwing for a briefing on a mobile Scourge remnant moving toward the uncertain southern border. Neither Halduron nor the unit knows that other forces are operating nearby. During a longer pursuit, the blood elves find precise black-fletched kills and altered ranger signs that suggest unknown hunters shadowing the same roads. They eventually discover their Scourge target already in combat with an all-paladin Argent Dawn patrol from Light’s Hope Chapel, including Falanaras’s old human friend Edric Hale on temporary Stormwind delegation, and intervene as the paladins are about to be overwhelmed. After the first Scourge group begins to break, a second force crashes into the battle with an abomination; Forsaken Dark Rangers led by Serenya Duskrunner arrive in pursuit of that reinforcement and help destroy it. Falanaras studies the paladins’ disciplined use of the Light while Edric initially greets him with warmth, then recoils at the sin’dorei’s green eyes, fel-supported condition, and willingness to stand beside Forsaken. Serenya’s patrol remains comparatively indifferent to the blood elves’ taint. A tense postbattle standoff threatens violence but ends when the Argent commander states that the Dawn includes Forsaken members even though this patrol does not, invokes the order’s neutral anti-Scourge authority, and commands weapons lowered. The encounter leaves Falanaras with a precise memory of paladin discipline, a painful measure of old human friendship, the first practical basis for trust with Serenya, and growing concern that Rynel is losing control of his magical hunger and approaching the Wretched decline he once taught his soldiers to fear.
title: Chapter 4: Friends in Dark Places
